name: ghost_alias_reused_by_new_connection
description: An unresolved identity's frozen alias is legitimately reused. external_collide_and_rename leaves 'host1-Copy-2' out of the config entirely and its identity unresolved, carried forward at its stale pre-ambiguity projection. Duplicating another connection then picks that now-free name and creates a genuinely new connection there. Production must retire the ghost rather than let the newcomer inherit its UUID or display name (the deliberate retiring_ghost_uuids path in identity_repository_adapter). Minimized from a stress-profile failure whose exact-alias report counted the ghost's frozen alias as a live binding.
